assetCoverage.arrangement: 20 kinds with five instances each: idle, walk, attack, cast for compatible casters (attack otherwise), and retained attack direction with idle/walk. Owner alternates by instance group, so every kind appears on both teams.
assetCoverage.actionFacts: Deterministic release facts and displacement only; no simulation advances in presentation samples. Attacks and casts target positions of another visible unit. Targets may be distant because this is an asset streaming probe, not combat validation.

cycles.scope: Controlled mixed 20-kind / 100-visible-unit presentation fixture, no simulation or combat execution. Full authored density 4 and original tile/mip/lighting/shadow paths. WorldPresentation production actor WebGL + ground Canvas + overlay Canvas. CPU samples disable renderer.render only; real Canvas submission and other resource work remain. Snapshot construction, simulation, capture, GC are excluded. Canvas deferred work and GPU completion are separately represented by real complete-wall samples; complete wall includes fence polling/event-loop scheduling, not GPU timer-query duration or hardware FPS.

variant.name: ordered-bank-1-native
variant.setup: World3DLayer.create, before prepare/first draw; cached card and remains maxTextureBanks set directly; no per-frame observer

latencyProfile.scope: Browser tracing and User Timing are active. World draw measures retain exact performance timestamps; only getImageData/copy calls over 1ms emit individual User Timing spans. Canvas/copy synchronous wall can include deferred execution, GC or channel waiting; trace evidence is required for attribution. All trace hooks add observer overhead. Diagnostic inclusive synchronous wrappers, not formal timing. Nested timings overlap; do not sum them. performance.now/aggregation/row bookkeeping add observation overhead. World layer excludes Canvas passes and true GPU completion; renderer calls include submission/backpressure, not pure GPU duration. The frozen fixture deliberately replaces renderer.render with a no-op during CPU warmup/samples; these rows report rendererRenderHookActive=false. No extra stats() calls, card traversal, GL calls, paints, uploads or rendering are introduced. Snapshot serialization/SHA happens only after each cycle, outside timed draws.
latencyProfile.snapshotHashDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(original snapshot), calculated after cycle; rows reference snapshot index, not a rewritten/render-mutated fixture. Raw final visible facts remain in harness pixelProof.

method: 8345 CURRENT-PRODUCTION STALL DIAGNOSTIC WITH OBSERVER OVERHEAD, NOT FORMAL TIMING OR AN EXPLANATION OF A PREVIOUS UNOBSERVED STALL. No historical provider substitutions. Current peak/mask/cache/uploader/ordering are unchanged. Two complete mixed100 hidden0 oneNative lifetimes, 18 real prep draws n0..51, 60 warm n54..113, all 60 CPU samples n114..173, all 12 real frames n480..491, empty/return probes and original between-lifetime explicit GC retained. No frame selection or new GPU synchronization. CPU section disables renderer.render only, so uploads, Canvas execution and driver backpressure remain possible. Natural GC may occur within timed calls; explicit harness GC is outside draws. All stage deltas and method wrappers are diagnostic; inclusive costs overlap and cannot be summed. Trace polling/scheduler costs are not pure GPU duration. Same fact fixture, screenshots and raw facts retained for separate strict comparison; matching pixels are not asserted without that check. Compression occurs after browser shutdown.
